positionReason: Figma boxes of auto-width text are whole numbers while the same text measures fractionally in Flutter (Inter 4.1 measures 'Cancel' at 53.109 against Figma's 53); half a logical pixel is the largest rounding Figma's integer boxes can hide.
channelDeltaReason: Out of 255 per RGBA channel. Corner antialiasing and a 1 px glyph offset differ between Figma's renderer and Flutter's even with the same font; on node 1:92 pixels over 32 are 3.71% with Inter and 22.08% with Flutter's test font, so 32 separates a real difference from renderer noise. Measured 2026-10-03 on the ten fixture nodes (CONTRIBUTING.md, Render check).
maxDifferingRatioReason: Share of pixels over channelDelta that fails the image check. Measured 2026-10-03 on the ten fixture nodes: renders that match the design differ by 0.00% (probes 2:15, 2:19, 2:23, 2:27) and 3.71% (text of 1:92, outside Flutter's overflow stripe); renders with a layout defect differ by 6.22% to 19.71%. 5% is the smallest round value above the largest correct render.
